description: The temporary wooden ramp leading to the East Gate shoe-cover distribution station is weathered and unstable for electric wheelchair users. Needs non-slip rubber grip and structural stabilization.

timeline.note: Citizen condition report logged via YatraVerse Portal with geo-tag at East Gate.
Report audited and verified by UP Tourism Grievance Cell.
Assigned to Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Agra Circle Conservation Team.
Replacement modular high-traction ramp procured; installation underway during non-visiting hours.

description: Two drinking water taps on the eastern promenade water station are leaking and require valve replacement. Water pooling creates slip hazard near the ferry jetty queue.

timeline.note: Citizen report logged with photo attachment.
BMC A-Ward water maintenance wing notified.
Assigned to Colaba Maintenance Field Squad.
Heavy-duty push valves installed and drainage grates unclogged. Inspected and verified clean.

description: Interpretive history signage panel near Diwan-i-Khas pavilion has sun fading on English and Braille text. Several foreign and visually impaired travelers inquired about monument context.

timeline.note: Guide report submitted highlighting Braille legibility issue.
Logged by Delhi Circle ASI Signage Standardization Cell for replacement printing.
